title: 第017章 装第018章 露馅
content_zh:
第017章装
“谁是这的老板？”光头身后，一个染着黄毛的青年，趾高气扬的喊道。
一众同学顿时一惊，这三人看上去就不是什么好人，难道是来闹事的？
只有周豪，悄悄低下头，嘴角露出一抹无人察觉的笑意。
蒋瑶有些紧张的站起来，声音有些颤抖：“不好意思，今天本店刚开业，暂时不招待客人，如果几位大哥要吃饭，请去别家吧！”
三人顿时把目光集中在蒋瑶身上，目光中带着侵略的意味。
“哟呵，还有这么俊俏的妹子，小妹妹，告诉哥哥，你是这家饭店的什么人啊？”光头说着，直接一脸坏笑的朝蒋瑶走过来。
“你们是谁？想要干什么！”蒋瑶妈妈听到动静，从后厨走出来，怒视着光头问。
光头顿时停下脚步，转头看向蒋瑶妈妈：“你是这的老板？”
“是，你们有何贵干？”蒋瑶妈妈一脸冷淡道。
“有何贵干？她问我有何贵干？兄弟们，你们告诉她咱们有何贵干？”光头夸张的对着两个小弟大笑着说。
两个小弟也跟着一阵坏笑，其中一人说道：“你们既然在这里开餐馆，难道就没有提前打听一下，这条街的门面，是谁罩着的？”
“就是虎哥，在这条街，虎哥就是这个！”
那青年自问自答，伸出手，高高竖起大拇指，一脸得意。
陈默等一众人顿时明白过来，这三人，是来收保护费的！
蒋瑶妈妈也是瞬间明白三人来意，顿时气不打一处来：“我管你虎哥狗哥，我有营业执照，有卫生许可证，你们要是敢乱来，我就报景！”
光头顿时脸色阴沉下来，冷笑道：“以前也有很多刚来到这里的愣头青说要报景，但最后他们都血本无归的滚出这条街，想要在这条街上做生意，就要服从我张虎订下的规矩！”
“你们想怎么样？”这时，蒋瑶的爸爸也穿着围裙，从后厨走出来，手里还拿着一个勺子，脸色凝重。
光头搓着手指，轻笑道：“老规矩，一年一万块钱，我保你在这条街平平安安！”
“一年一万，你怎么不去抢？我们一年才赚多少钱？”蒋瑶妈妈气的身体都在颤抖。

光头眉头一皱，拉过一张椅子大摇大摆坐下，翘起二郎腿，并且掏出一根烟，旁边那个小弟立刻给他点上火。
光头深吸一口，吐出一口烟气：“这么说你们是不打算交喽？”
蒋瑶妈妈正准备张口拒绝，却被蒋瑶爸爸拉住：“不是不交，只是我们小本生意，一年下来也赚不了几个钱，一年一万，实在太多了！”
光头有些不耐烦：“别废话，我就问你一句话，交是不交？”
蒋瑶妈妈冲口喊道：“我们凭什么交，你以为你是谁？我告诉你，现在是法治社会，还玩过去收保护费那一套，早就过时了。”
光头脸色阴沉到了极点，看着蒋瑶爸爸问：“这就是你们的回答？”
蒋瑶爸爸犹豫一阵，看了眼旁边一脸怒气的妻子，眼神也变得坚定起来：“她的话，就是我的回答。”
“呵呵，行啊，有段时间没碰到过你们这样的刺头了。阿杰，打电话把人都叫来，以后就把食堂，定在这了！”光头说完，往椅子上一躺，一脸无赖状。
“明白！”那青年掏出手机，开始打电话。
蒋瑶妈妈脸色一变：“我打电话报景！”
光头眉毛一挑，古怪的笑道：“报景？好啊！我等着。”
蒋瑶妈妈一直都坚信，这个世界是有公理的，立刻拨打报景电话：“你好，我们这里有人闹事。”
电话那端一个女声响起：“有人受伤吗？”
蒋瑶妈妈如实回答：“没有！”
“有损坏财物吗？”
“没有！”
“哦，那把你的位置说清楚，我马上叫片景过去！”
content_en:
Chapter 017 Pretending
"Who is the boss here?" Behind the bald man, a young man with dyed yellow hair shouted arrogantly.
All the students were shocked. These three people didn't look like good people. Could they be here to cause trouble?
Only Zhou Hao quietly lowered his head and revealed a smile that no one noticed.
Jiang Yao stood up nervously, her voice trembling: "Sorry, our store has just opened today and we are not accepting guests for the time being. If you guys want to eat, please go elsewhere!"
The three people immediately focused their attention on Jiang Yao, with a hint of aggression in their eyes.
"Oh, there is such a pretty girl. Little sister, tell me brother, who do you belong to in this hotel?" Baldhead said, walking towards Jiang Yao with a smirk on his face.
"Who are you? What do you want to do!" Jiang Yao's mother heard the commotion and walked out of the kitchen, glaring at the bald head and asking.
The bald man stopped immediately and turned to look at Jiang Yao's mother: "Are you the boss here?"
"Yes, what are you doing?" Jiang Yao's mother said coldly.
"What's the big deal? She asked me what's the big deal? Brothers, tell her what's the big deal?" the bald head said with an exaggerated smile to the two younger brothers.
The two boys also laughed evilly, and one of them said: "Since you opened a restaurant here, didn't you ask in advance who is covering the facade of this street?"
"That's Brother Tiger. In this street, Brother Tiger is this one!"
The young man asked and answered himself, stretched out his hand, gave a thumbs up, and looked proud.
Chen Mo and others suddenly understood that these three people were here to collect protection money!
Jiang Yao's mother also instantly understood the intention of the three people, and she was immediately furious: "I don't care about you, Brother Tiger, Brother Dog. I have a business license and a health permit. If you dare to mess around, I will report the situation!"
The bald man's face suddenly darkened, and he sneered: "In the past, there were many stupid young people who just came here and said they wanted to report the scene, but in the end they all left this street without losing their money. If you want to do business on this street, you must obey the rules set by me, Zhang Hu!"
"What do you want?" At this time, Jiang Yao's father, also wearing an apron, walked out of the kitchen with a spoon in his hand and a solemn expression.
The bald man rubbed his fingers and chuckled: "Old rules, for ten thousand yuan a year, I'll keep you safe on this street!"
"Ten thousand a year, why don't you grab it? How much money do we make in a year?" Jiang Yao's mother was so angry that her body was shaking.
The bald man frowned, pulled up a chair and swaggered down, crossed his legs, and took out a cigarette. The boy next to him immediately lit it for him.
The bald man took a deep breath and exhaled a puff of smoke: "So you guys don't plan on dating?"
Jiang Yao's mother was about to open her mouth to refuse, but was stopped by Jiang Yao's father: "It's not that we don't pay, it's just that we have a small business and we can't make much money in a year. Ten thousand a year is really too much!"
The bald head was a little impatient: "Don't talk nonsense, I just want to ask you a question, do you want to hand over your money or not?"
Jiang Yao's mother yelled: "Why should we pay each other? Who do you think you are? Let me tell you, in a society governed by the rule of law, the old method of collecting protection fees has long been outdated."
The bald man's face was extremely gloomy. He looked at Jiang Yao's father and asked, "Is this your answer?"
Jiang Yao's father hesitated for a while, then glanced at his angry wife next to him, and his eyes became firm: "Her words are my answer."
"Haha, okay, I haven't encountered such a thorny person like you for a while. Ajie, call everyone here, and the canteen will be located here from now on!" After the bald man finished speaking, he lay down on the chair with a rogue look on his face.
"Understood!" The young man took out his cell phone and started making a call.
Jiang Yao's mother's face changed: "I'll call to report the scene!"
The bald man raised his eyebrows and said with a weird smile: "Scene report? Okay! I'll wait."Jiang Yao's mother has always believed that there is justice in this world, so she immediately called the phone number to report the situation: "Hello, someone is making trouble here."
A female voice sounded on the other end of the phone: "Is anyone hurt?"
Jiang Yao’s mother answered truthfully: “No!”
"Was there any damage to property?"
"No!"
"Oh, tell me your location clearly, and I'll call Pianjing over right away!"
